correctness.rationale: The finite-cycle generator specifies per-site isolated-death rate 1 and facilitated-birth hazard theta counted once per zero; any adjacent occupied pair permanently precludes the empty state. For each maximal alternating block m, the first-event hazard is m+theta(m+1) and convolution gives ((1+theta)m+theta)a_m=sum a_j a_(m-1-j). Its Riccati ODE and 0F1 identity determine the Bessel ratio uniquely. The marked cyclic block/gap decomposition counts all independent initial sets; the special all-alternating even cycle has m rather than m+1 birth hazards and is corrected explicitly. For positive p,q,theta, the first positive 0F1 pole and positive coefficients give a unique root q R A(p q R^2)=1; the coefficient of x in f(x)=qxA(pqx^2) enforces the only root on |x|=R, yielding unit-residue asymptotic b_L=R^(-L)+O(r^(-L)). For theta=1, A=tan(sqrt(z))/sqrt(z) gives the stated rate. All boundary restrictions p in (0,1), theta>0,L>=3 are respected.
residual_risks: Dominant pole conclusion uses the classical all-real-zero theorem for J_{alpha-1}, alpha in (0,1); this standard result was not re-proved.
Finite rational equalities do not prove the full infinite-size asymptotic; proof is analytic.
